summary: Los Padres peak lookout: a CL-100 cab on an 11-foot block tower built 1964; the cab moved to Smith Mountain in 1976 and the tower is now marked removed.

facts.status_note: The cab was moved to Smith Mountain; a photo caption marks the 11-foot block tower as now removed.

CL-100 cab on an 11-foot block tower; the register also shows an earlier BC-301 cabin with an AWS residence.
CL-100 cab moved from Black Mountain to Smith Mountain and placed on a 10-foot block tower by CalFire.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief dates the build to 1964. A 1954 clipping shows a station already staffed on the peak, and FFLOS's photo caption names an earlier BC-301 cabin. The story reports both.
FFLOS gives the transfer and relocation without a date; the Smith Mountain register gives 1976 with CalFire placing the cab. The story uses 1976.

notes_for_editor: The brief's kind (two_story) is left as recorded; FFLOS describes a CL-100 cab on an 11-foot block tower. The brief's fflos_registered date (December 22, 2019) is not visible in the cached FFLOS text, so it is left out. The 11-foot tower is converted to 3.4 m for height_m. No access information was found for the peak. A Los Padres trail page for Black Mountain Trail was found but does not name the lookout, so it was not used. The Smith Mountain page is a different site and its registration date (June 19, 2010) is not used for this lookout. A Los Padres lookout list (Black Mountain 1964, 11 ft) was seen only as a search snippet and not fetched, so it is not cited.
